about: REQ-041 agent setup evals. Each case replays a past mistake, review finding or rule against the real Compass checks. expect: blocked | allowed; why: a regular expression the blocking message must match. Placeholders: {{repo}}, {{secret:<kind>}}, {{goodPrBody}}, {{goodPlanFile}}. Never delete a case or change its expect/why: add "retired": "<Product Owner approval, date>" instead (compass/REVIEW.md). Run: node compass/eval-agent-setup.mjs
